role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Leasing Arrangements

role.documentation: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other

role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from estimated losses under self insurance.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Leasing Arrangements

role.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost

role.label: Depreciation And Amortization Percent
role.documentation: Depreciation and amortization as a percentage of net sales.

role.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
role.documentation: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

role.label: Depreciation, Nonproduction
role.documentation: The expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of nonproduction tangible assets over their useful lives.

role.documentation: All the names of the entities being reported upon in a document. Any legal structure used to conduct activities or to hold assets. role.documentation: The entire disclosure for the fair value of financial instruments (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined), and the measurements of those instruments as well as disclosures related to the fair value of non-financial assets and liabilities. Such disclosures about the financial instruments, assets, and liabilities would include: (1) the fair value of the required items together with their carrying amounts (as appropriate); (2) for items for which it is not practicable to estimate fair value, disclosure would include: (a) information pertinent to estimating fair value (including, carrying amount, effective interest rate, and maturity, and (b) the reasons why it is not practicable to estimate fair value; (3) significant concentrations of credit risk including: (a) information about the activity, region, or economic characteristics identifying a concentration, (b) the maximum amount of loss the entity is exposed to based on the gross fair value of the related item, (c) policy for requiring collateral or other security and information as to accessing such collateral or security, and (d) the nature and brief description of such collateral or security; (4) quantitative information about market risks and how such risks are managed; (5) for items measured on both a recurring and nonrecurring basis information regarding the inputs used to develop the fair value measurement; and (6) for items presented in the financial statement for which fair value measurement is elected: (a) information necessary to understand the reasons for the election, (b) discussion of the effect of fair value changes on earnings, (c) a description of [similar groups] items for which the election is made and the relation thereof to the balance sheet, the aggregate carrying value of items included in the balance sheet that are not eligible for the election; (7) all other required (as defined) and desired information.

role.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
role.documentation: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

role.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
role.documentation: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

role.label: Long-Lived Tangible Asset [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

role.label: Property, Plant and Equipment Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for long-lived, physical asset used in normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Includes, but is not limited to, work of art, historical treasure, and similar asset classified as collections.

role.label: Property, Plant and Equipment [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for long-lived, physical asset used in normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Includes, but is not limited to, work of art, historical treasure, and similar asset classified as collections.

role.verboseLabel: Schedule of Property, Plant and Equipment
role.label: Property, Plant and Equipment [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Includes, but is not limited to, balances by class of assets, depreciation and depletion expense and method used, including composite depreciation, and accumulated deprecation.

role.label: Long-Lived Tangible Asset [Domain]
role.documentation: Listing of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include land, buildings, machinery and equipment, and other types of furniture and equipment including, but not limited to, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment and software.

role.terseLabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Useful Life
role.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Useful Life
role.documentation: Useful life of long lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Examples include, but not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

role.label: Statistical Measurement [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by statistical measurement. Includes, but is not limited to, minimum, maximum, weighted average, arithmetic average, and median.

role.label: Statistical Measurement [Domain]
role.documentation: Statistical measurement. Includes, but is not limited to, minimum, maximum, weighted average, arithmetic average, and median.

role.label: Receivables, Net, Current
role.documentation: The total amount due to the entity within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

role.label: Receivable [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for receivable. Includes, but is not limited to, accounts receivable and financing receivable.

role.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.label: Recovery of Erroneously Awarded Compensation Disclosure [Line Items]
Related and Nonrelated Parties [Domain]
role.documentation: Related and nonrelated parties. Related party includes, but is not limited to, affiliate, other entity for which investment is accounted for under equity method, trust for benefit of employee, principal owner, management, and member of immediate family, and other party that may be prevented from pursuing separate interests because of control, significant influence, or ownership interest.

role.label: Related Party [Member]
role.documentation: Party related to reporting entity. Includes, but is not limited to, affiliate, entity for which investment is accounted for by equity method, trust for benefit of employees, and principal owner, management, and members of immediate family.

role.label: Related Party Transaction [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Related Party Transaction, Purchases from Related Party
role.documentation: Purchases during the period (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.

role.label: Related and Nonrelated Parties [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by related and nonrelated parties. Related party includes, but is not limited to, affiliate, other entity for which investment is accounted for under equity method, trust for benefit of employee, principal owner, management, and member of immediate family, and other party that may be prevented from pursuing separate interests because of control, significant influence, or ownership interest.

role.label: Related Party Transactions Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for related party transactions. Examples of related party transactions include transactions between (a) a parent company and its subsidiary; (b) subsidiaries of a common parent; (c) and entity and its principal owners; and (d) affiliates.

role.label: Repayments of Debt
role.documentation: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of lease obligation.

role.label: Reportable Segment [Member]
role.documentation: Reportable Segment

role.label: Restatement Does Not Require Recovery [Text Block]
Restricted Stock [Member]
role.documentation: Stock including a provision that prohibits sale or substantive sale of an equity instrument for a specified period of time or until specified performance conditions are met.

role.label: Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) [Member]
role.documentation: Share instrument which is convertible to stock or an equivalent amount of cash, after a specified period of time or when specified performance conditions are met.

role.label: Retail Home Improvement [Member]
role.documentation: Retail Home Improvement

role.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
role.documentation: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

role.label: Retained Earnings [Member]
role.documentation: Accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

role.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
role.documentation: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

role.label: Revenue From Contract With Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax, Percentage
role.documentation: Revenue From Contract With Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax, Percentage

role.label: Revenue From Contract With Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax, Percentage Of Operating Income
role.documentation: Revenue From Contract With Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax, Percentage Of Operating Income

role.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for revenue from contract with customer.

role.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure of revenue from contract with customer to transfer good or service and to transfer nonfinancial asset. Includes, but is not limited to, disaggregation of revenue, credit loss recognized from contract with customer, judgment and change in judgment related to contract with customer, and asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer. Excludes insurance and lease contracts.

role.terseLabel: Summary of Net Sales Disaggregated by Geographical Area
role.label: Revenue from External Customers by Geographic Areas [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of revenue from external customers by geographic areas attributed to the entity's country of domicile and to foreign countries from which the entity derives revenue.

role.label: Revolving Credit Facilities [Member]
role.documentation: Revolving Credit Facilities

role.label: Revolving Credit Facility [Member]
role.documentation: Arrangement in which loan proceeds can continuously be obtained following repayments, but the total amount borrowed cannot exceed a specified maximum amount.

role.terseLabel: Leased assets obtained in exchange for new finance lease liabilities
role.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability
role.documentation: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for finance lease liability.

role.terseLabel: Leased assets obtained in exchange for new operating lease liabilities
role.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
role.documentation: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Outstanding Financed Payment Obligations
role.label: Rollforward Of Outstanding Financed Payment Obligations [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Rollforward Of Outstanding Financed Payment Obligations

role.label: Rough Plumbing [Member]
role.documentation: Rough Plumbing

role.label: Sales and Excise Tax Payable, Current
role.documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred through that date and payable for statutory sales and use taxes, including value added tax. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

role.label: Sales Revenue Net Percent
role.documentation: Net sales as a percentage of net sales.

role.label: Business Combination [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, recognized asset and liability.

role.verboseLabel: Schedule of Cash Flow, Supplemental Disclosures
role.label: Schedule of Cash Flow, Supplemental Disclosures [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of supplemental cash flow information for the periods presented.

role.verboseLabel: Schedule of Components of Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
role.label: Schedule of Components of Income Tax Expense (Benefit) [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the components of income tax expense attributable to continuing operations for each year presented including, but not limited to: current tax expense (benefit), deferred tax expense (benefit), investment tax credits, government grants, the benefits of operating loss carryforwards, tax expense that results from allocating certain tax benefits either directly to contributed capital or to reduce goodwill or other noncurrent intangible assets of an acquired entity, adjustments of a deferred tax liability or asset for enacted changes in tax laws or rates or a change in the tax status of the entity, and adjustments of the beginning-of-the-year balances of a valuation allowance because of a change in circumstances that causes a change in judgment about the realizability of the related deferred tax asset in future years.

role.label: Schedule of Long-Term Debt Instruments [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of long-debt instruments or arrangements, including identification, terms, features, collateral requirements and other information necessary to a fair presentation. These are debt arrangements that originally required repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

role.verboseLabel: Schedule of Deferred Tax Assets and Liabilities
role.label: Schedule of Deferred Tax Assets and Liabilities [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the components of net deferred tax asset or liability recognized in an entity's statement of financial position, including the following: the total of all deferred tax liabilities, the total of all deferred tax assets, the total valuation allowance recognized for deferred tax assets.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Earnings Per Share, Basic and Diluted
role.label: Schedule of Earnings Per Share, Basic and Diluted [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of an entity's basic and diluted earnings per share calculations, including a reconciliation of numerators and denominators of the basic and diluted per-share computations for income from continuing operations.

role.verboseLabel: Schedule of Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation
role.label: Schedule of Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the reconciliation using percentage or dollar amounts of the reported amount of income tax expense attributable to continuing operations for the year to the amount of income tax expense that would result from applying domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

role.terseLabel: Segment Reporting, Revenue from External Customer, Product and Service [Table]
role.label: Segment Reporting, Revenue from External Customer, Product and Service [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about revenue from external customer by product and service when not provided as part of reportable operating segment information.

role.label: Revenue from External Customers by Products and Services [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of entity-wide revenues from external customers for each product or service or each group of similar products or services if the information is not provided as part of the reportable operating segment information.

role.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes indefinite-lived intangible asset.

role.label: Goodwill [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about goodwill, including, but not limited to, change from acquisition, sale, impairment, and other reason.

role.label: Schedule of Goodwill [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of goodwill by reportable segment and in total which includes a rollforward schedule.

role.verboseLabel: Schedule of Intangible Assets and Goodwill
role.label: Schedule of Intangible Assets and Goodwill [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of goodwill and intangible assets, which may be broken down by segment or major class.

role.label: Schedule of Interest Rate Derivatives [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of interest rate derivatives, including, but not limited to, the fair value of the derivatives, statement of financial position location, and statement of financial performance location of these instruments.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Maturities of Long-term Debt
role.label: Schedule of Maturities of Long-Term Debt [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of maturity and sinking fund requirement for long-term debt.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Performance Share Units Activity
role.label: Schedule of Nonvested Performance-Based Units Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the changes in outstanding nonvested performance-based units.

role.verboseLabel: Schedule of Restricted Stock Unit Activity
role.label: Schedule of Nonvested Restricted Stock Units Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the changes in outstanding nonvested restricted stock units.

role.label: Schedule Of Other Current Liabilities [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of other current liabilities not separately disclosed on the balance sheet.

role.label: Property, Plant and Equipment [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Includes, but is not limited to, balances by class of assets, depreciation and depletion expense and method used, including composite depreciation, and accumulated deprecation.

role.label: Business Combination, Recognized Asset Acquired and Liability Assumed [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of asset acquired and liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

role.label: Related Party Transaction [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about related party transaction.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Segment Reporting Information, by Segment [Table]
role.label: Schedule of Segment Reporting Information, by Segment [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about profit (loss) and total assets by reportable segment.

role.label: Schedule of Segment Reporting Information, by Segment [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the profit or loss and total assets for each reportable segment. An entity discloses certain information on each reportable segment if the amounts (a) are included in the measure of segment profit or loss reviewed by the chief operating decision maker or (b) are otherwise regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker, even if not included in that measure of segment profit or loss.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award [Table]
role.label: Schedule of Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonemployee Director Award Plan, Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the number and weighted-average exercise prices (or conversion ratios) for stock awards granted to nonemployee directors that were outstanding at the beginning and end of the year, and the number of awards that were granted, exercised or converted, forfeited, and expired during the year.

role.verboseLabel: Schedule of Restricted Stock Awards Activity
role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock Unit, Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the number and weighted-average grant date fair value for restricted stock units that were outstanding at the beginning and end of the year, and the number of restricted stock units that were granted, vested, or forfeited during the year.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure for stock option plans. Includes, but is not limited to, outstanding awards at beginning and end of year, grants, exercises, forfeitures, and weighted-average grant date fair value.

role.verboseLabel: Schedule of Performance Share Units Pricing Assumptions
role.label: Schedule Of Share Based Payment Award, Performance Share Units, Valuation Assumptions [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the significant assumptions used during the year to estimate the fair value of performance shares, including, but not limited to: (a) expected term of performance shares and similar instruments, (b) expected volatility of the entity's shares, (c) expected dividends, and (d) risk-free rate(s)

role.label: Schedule of Share-Based Payment Award, Stock Options, Valuation Assumptions [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the significant assumptions used during the year to estimate the fair value of stock options, including, but not limited to: (a) expected term of share options and similar instruments, (b) expected volatility of the entity's shares, (c) expected dividends, (d) risk-free rate(s), and (e) discount for post-vesting restrictions.

role.label: Schedule of Share Repurchases [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the number of shares repurchased during the period, including the corresponding cost.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Unrecognized Tax Benefits Roll Forward
role.label: Schedule of Unrecognized Tax Benefits Roll Forward [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the change in unrecognized tax benefits.

role.label: Schedule of Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Future Amortization Expense [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the amount of amortization expense expected to be recorded in succeeding fiscal years for finite-lived intangible assets.

role.label: Seasonal And Outdoor Living [Member]
role.documentation: Disclosures related to total revenue from sale of goods and services rendered during the reporting period, included in the Seasonal and Outdoor Living product category.

role.label: Secured Debt [Member]
role.documentation: Collateralized debt obligation backed by, for example, but not limited to, pledge, mortgage or other lien on the entity's assets.

role.label: Title of 12(b) Security
role.documentation: Title of a 12(b) registered security.

role.label: Security Exchange Name
role.documentation: Name of the Exchange on which a security is registered.

role.label: Segments [Domain]
role.documentation: Components of an entity that engage in business activities from which they may earn revenue and incur expenses, including transactions with other components of the same entity.

role.label: Geographical [Domain]
role.documentation: Geographical area.

role.label: Segment Reporting Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for reporting segments including data and tables. Reportable segments include those that meet any of the following quantitative thresholds a) it's reported revenue, including sales to external customers and intersegment sales or transfers is 10 percent or more of the combined revenue, internal and external, of all operating segments b) the absolute amount of its reported profit or loss is 10 percent or more of the greater, in absolute amount of 1) the combined reported profit of all operating segments that did not report a loss or 2) the combined reported loss of all operating segments that did report a loss c) its assets are 10 percent or more of the combined assets of all operating segments.

role.label: Segment Reporting Information [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Self Insurance Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Describes an entity's policy to account for estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's' compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

role.label: Self Insurance Reserve
role.documentation: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions) of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

role.label: Self Insurance Reserve, Current
role.documentation: Carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property that are expected to be paid within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

role.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
role.documentation: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

role.label: Selling General And Administrative Expense Percent
role.documentation: Selling, general and administrative expense as a percentage of net sales.

role.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for inclusion of significant items in the selling, general and administrative (or similar) expense report caption.

role.label: September 2025 Notes [Member]
role.documentation: September 2025 Notes

role.terseLabel: Business Combination, Series of Individually Immaterial Business Combinations
role.label: Business Combination, Series of Individually Immaterial Business Combinations [Member]
role.documentation: Series of individually immaterial business combinations.

role.label: Service [Member]
role.documentation: Assistance, including, but not limited to, technology, license and maintenance, license and service, maintenance, oil and gas, and financial service.

role.verboseLabel: Service requirement to receive company match
role.label: Service Requirement Period Of Time
role.documentation: The minimum period that the individual is required to perform services in order to enroll in and be eligible to receive the company match on contributions made to the plan, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
role.documentation: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Award Requisite Service Period
role.documentation: Estimated period over which an employee is required to provide service in exchange for the equity-based payment award, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Award Vesting Period
role.documentation: Period over which grantee's right to exercise award under share-based payment arrangement is no longer contingent on satisfaction of service or performance condition, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but is not limited to, combination of market, performance or service condition.

role.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Contractual Term
role.documentation: Contractual term, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Discount from Market Price, Purchase Date
role.documentation: Discount rate from fair value on purchase date that participants pay for shares.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
role.documentation: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were forfeited during the reporting period.

role.verboseLabel: Canceled or forfeited (in dollars per share)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
role.documentation: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event.

role.terseLabel: Deferred shares granted to non-employee directors (in shares)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
role.documentation: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

role.terseLabel: Weighted-average grant date fair value per share (in dollars per share)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
role.documentation: The weighted average fair value at grant date for nonvested equity-based awards issued during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number
role.documentation: The number of non-vested equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that validly exist and are outstanding as of the balance sheet date.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.periodStartLabel: Nonvested, beginning balance (in dollars per share)
role.periodEndLabel: Nonvested, ending balance (in dollars per share)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
role.documentation: Per share or unit weighted-average fair value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

role.terseLabel: Weighted-Average Grant-Date Fair Value Per Share
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period
role.documentation: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that vested during the reporting period.

role.terseLabel: Total fair value of awards vested
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Fair Value
role.documentation: Fair value of share-based awards for which the grantee gained the right by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
role.documentation: The weighted average fair value as of grant date pertaining to an equity-based award plan other than a stock (or unit) option plan for which the grantee gained the right during the reporting period, by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash in accordance with the terms of the arrangement.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions and Methodology [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Rate
role.documentation: The estimated dividend rate (a percentage of the share price) to be paid (expected dividends) to holders of the underlying shares over the option's term.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate
role.documentation: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Weighted Average Volatility Rate
role.documentation: Rate of weighted-average expected volatility for award under share-based payment arrangement.

role.terseLabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award [Line Items]
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.terseLabel: Shares authorized for grant under active plans (in shares)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement By Share-based Payment Award, Number Of Shares Authorized Under Active Plans
role.documentation: The maximum number of shares (or other type of equity) originally approved (usually by shareholders and board of directors), net of any subsequent amendments and adjustments, for awards under active equity-based compensation plans.

role.verboseLabel: Remaining shares available for grant under active plans (in shares)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Number of Shares Available for Grant
role.documentation: The difference between the maximum number of shares (or other type of equity) authorized for issuance under the plan (including the effects of amendments and adjustments), and the sum of: 1) the number of shares (or other type of equity) already issued upon exercise of options or other equity-based awards under the plan; and 2) shares (or other type of equity) reserved for issuance on granting of outstanding awards, net of cancellations and forfeitures, if applicable.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement By Share-based Payment Award, Offering Period
role.documentation: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement By Share-based Payment Award, Offering Period

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
role.documentation: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
role.documentation: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

role.verboseLabel: Total intrinsic value of options exercised
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Intrinsic Value
role.documentation: Amount of accumulated difference between fair value of underlying shares on dates of exercise and exercise price on options exercised (or share units converted) into shares.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period
